The primary biological variable is the PTM state (specifically acetylation and methylation) of the histones within the nucleosomes that are selectively bound by BRD4L compared to the total pool (input library). While the study uses small-molecule inhibitors (JQ1) and genetic mutants in other assays (MST, SPR), these were not the primary variables for the MS-analyzed samples described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Extraction and digestion of endogenous mononucleosomes' section.
